# Hirewright

> Hirewright is an industrial staffing company that recruits skilled and semi-skilled crews from Central Europe and places them on German industrial sites. Operating since 2001, with more than 1,500 workers deployed. You pay only for hours worked. Housing, transport, and paperwork are handled.

## What Hirewright does

Hirewright places skilled and semi-skilled workers onto German manufacturing, construction, logistics, and shipyard sites. Full operational support is included: housing, transport, paperwork, sick leave, and integration. Rates are published by category and billed per hour worked. No retainer, no upfront fee.

## Sourcing countries

Workers are recruited across a four-country network:

- Hungary
- Romania
- Poland
- Slovakia

When one pipeline is tight, another fills the gap, so crews mobilise in days, not months.

## Service categories and hourly rates (2026, EUR per hour)

- Skilled trades — welders (including certified), electricians, HVAC technicians, fitters, machinists — from 29 EUR/hr
- Industrial specialists — sprinkler installation, calibration technicians, security system installers — from 29 EUR/hr
- Construction and finishing — painters, pipefitters, general construction — from 25 EUR/hr
- Semi-skilled production — assembly line workers, packagers, machine operators — from 20 EUR/hr
- Logistics and warehouse — warehouse workers, forklift operators, drivers — from 20 EUR/hr
- Cleaning and maintenance — residential and commercial cleaning crews, specialised industrial workers — from 19 EUR/hr

Rates are indicative and depend on role, volume, and duration. A precise quote is provided within 24 hours.

## Track record

- 25+ years of experience (since 2001)
- 1,500+ workers placed
- 4 countries in the sourcing network
- 30+ active partners
- Placements on projects associated with BMW Group, Mercedes-Benz, NATO, the Bremerhaven shipyard, and DPD

## Contact

To request workers or a price, use the request form at https://hirewright.eu/#request. You receive an indicative price the same day and a precise quote within 24 hours.
